## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated a test for the behavior I changed, and did not weaken, skip or delete a test.
- [ ] The READMEs and `docs/` still describe the shipped behavior.
- [ ] New user-facing text is in the i18n dictionaries (English and Traditional Chinese).
- [ ] New stored fields are optional, so older builds can still read the data.
- [ ] A new dependency has a stated reason above.
- [ ] No personal details or secrets in the diff.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), and I agree to license my contribution under the Apache License 2.0 (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`).
